Damian is very visual. Also, there are SO many things that have to happen on every prompt submit for me to be convinced all te system is working together.

The Ask:

1. I type a prompt in [Codex|Codex Desktop|Claude] and submit it

2. I can follow the prompt all the way through the system in the order it happens
  - OMG I want to "record" all the data produced as cause and effect -all the side effects - everything - kinda like Chrome tools when it tracks a network request. Pack it up in a propriotary structured dump that can then be read by "The Factory" 3d pipeline sim we made ! That's what the tour mode can be repurposed as. As an entertaining teaching device it fell flat, but as a tour of the components from the point of view of the actual prompt and data .... ! YES
